logline: The devas celebrate Gajendra's deliverance; Huhu returns home, Gajendra receives four-armed sārūpya-mukti through Hari's touch, and after speaking blessings the Lord sounds Pāñcajanya and departs on Garuḍa with Gajendra.

source.edition: Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam Canto 8 Chapter 4; originally worded contemporary Telugu/Hindi/English child-friendly narration, not copied English translation
source.verification_notes: 8.4.1–2: devas, sages and Gandharvas praise Hari, flowers/kettledrums, songs and dancing; no recordings are sourced. 8.4.5: restored Huhu circumambulates Lord, bows and returns to Gandharvaloka; restoration itself at 8.4.3–4 was already narrated in E05. 8.4.6: Hari's touch immediately frees Gajendra from ignorance and bestows spiritual four-armed, yellow-robed sārūpya (distinct from both original quadrupedal elephant and Hari). 8.4.13: after Gajendra liberation, Lord goes to His abode riding Garuda with liberated Gajendra. 8.4.14–15: hearing/story remembrance blessings. 8.4.16 and 17–24: Hari addresses Gajendra and praises recollection of Him and sacred sites/attributes, summarized not verbatim. 8.4.25: morning prayer/eternal spiritual benefit described, without claiming universal modern material reward. 8.4.26: Lord sounds Pāñcajanya and mounts Garuda to depart. Episode sequences the later explanation/flashback E05 before showing spiritual form E06 as editorial disclosure; this does NOT claim Gajendra's sārūpya was delayed from the original touch. S01: SB 8.4.1, 8.4.2 straightforward original paraphrase, staging separated from scripture. S02: SB 8.4.5 straightforward original paraphrase, staging separated from scripture. S03: SB 8.4.6 straightforward original paraphrase, staging separated from scripture. S04 source SB 8.4.16, 8.4.17-24, 8.4.25; The Lord's blessings and remembrance; specific gestures/camera notes attributed original. S05 source SB 8.4.26, 8.4.1, 8.4.2; The Pāñcajanya conch; specific gestures/camera notes attributed original.

core_preserved: All devas/sages/Gandharvas praise Hari, shower flowers and play celestial music (8.4.1–2).
Huhu, already restored to Gandharva identity by 8.4.3–4, bows and returns to Gandharvaloka (8.4.5).
By Lord's touch Gajendra immediately receives sārūpya-mukti, four arms and yellow garments, released from material ignorance (8.4.6).
Hari grants blessings and describes remembrance of His divine forms and sites in morning devotion (8.4.14–25).
The Lord blows the Pāñcajanya conch, mounts Garuda and leaves; Gajendra accompanies Him to His divine abode (8.4.13,26).
changes: The chapter's immediate sārūpya after rescue is visually shown in E06 because E05 first explains the backstories. This is editorial reveal order ONLY, not a new event in time; scene text discloses this.
The current visual identity approved by owner includes a distinct four-armed yellow-garbed spiritual associate for liberated Gajendra; do not make ordinary elephant grow human arms.
No copyrighted published verse translations, exact Sanskrit recitation, existing recorded kirtan or commercial music are introduced.
Celestial flowers, praise and drums are verse-grounded but voice/musical performances are not generated/approved; any original score cues remain future plans.
Source lists many sacred names/locations at 8.4.17–24; age-accessible condensed narrator wording explicitly not a literal mantra or a replacement for exact recitation.
No fabricated direct speech from Huhu, Gajendra or Narayana in the sourced narrator-only script; optional later direct speaking portraits would need new authorized lines.
S01: title Flowers and songs of praise; exactly three shot concepts and nonvoiced narrator-only wording, original cinematic holds not extra verses.
S02: title Hūhū's gratitude and departure; exactly three shot concepts and nonvoiced narrator-only wording, original cinematic holds not extra verses.
S03: title Gajendra's spiritual transformation; exactly three shot concepts and nonvoiced narrator-only wording, original cinematic holds not extra verses.
S04: source-faithful child-friendly editing; no unauthorized published translation, new vocal track, or automatic approval.
S05: source-faithful child-friendly editing; no unauthorized published translation, new vocal track, or automatic approval.

scenes.action: The Lord offers blessings, recounting mindful remembrance of His forms, the lake, Trikūṭa peaks, Sudarshana, conch, Garuda and noble devotion (8.4.16–25), including spiritual benefit of sincere morning prayer.
nonverbal_beats: Narayana in approved distinct four-arm divine form blesses Gajendra as a spiritual companion; do not accidentally use the ordinary quadrupedal Gajendra where the liberated form is now correct.

Trikūṭa with gold/silver/iron peaks and lotus lake already established in E01 can be returned to through a quick gentle visual memory, not a new location.
Do not draw unapproved named Narada, Prahlada or other listed historical personalities to fill the crowd; can mention source summary by narrator.
Blessing on morning remembrance and spiritual welfare (8.4.24–25) should not be misrepresented as automatic wishes/certain physical rewards for viewers.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: When Hari delivered Gajendra, the devas rejoiced.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడిని హరి రక్షించినప్పుడు దేవతలు సంతోషించారు.
text.hi: जब हरि ने गजेन्द्र को बचाया, देवता प्रसन्न हुए।
text.en: When Hari delivered Gajendra, the devas rejoiced.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Sages and Gandharvas praised the Lord.

text.te: మహర్షులు, గంధర్వులు కూడా భగవంతుడిని స్తుతించారు.
text.hi: ऋषियों और गंधर्वों ने भी भगवान की स्तुति की।
text.en: Sages and Gandharvas praised the Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Flowers showered down from the sky.

text.te: ఆకాశం నుంచి పూల వర్షం కురిసింది.
text.hi: आकाश से फूलों की वर्षा हुई।
text.en: Flowers showered down from the sky.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Everyone honored the Lord's compassion.

text.te: భగవంతుడి కరుణకు అందరూ కృతజ్ఞత చెప్పారు.
text.hi: सबने भगवान की करुणा की प्रशंसा की।
text.en: Everyone honored the Lord's compassion.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Heavenly kettledrums sounded.

text.te: దివ్యమైన దుందుభులు మోగాయి.
text.hi: दिव्य नगाड़े बज उठे।
text.en: Heavenly kettledrums sounded.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Gandharvas sang and danced with joy.

text.te: గంధర్వులు ఆనందంతో పాడారు, నాట్యం చేశారు.
text.hi: गंधर्व खुशी से गाने और नाचने लगे।
text.en: The Gandharvas sang and danced with joy.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Siddhas and Charanas praised the Supreme.

text.te: సిద్ధులు, చారణులు కూడా పరమాత్మను స్తుతించారు.
text.hi: सिद्ध और चारण भी परम भगवान की स्तुति करने लगे।
text.en: The Siddhas and Charanas praised the Supreme.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Their joy celebrated Gajendra's wonderful deliverance.

text.te: ఈ ఆనందం గజేంద్రుడి గొప్ప విముక్తిని గుర్తుచేసింది.
text.hi: यह उल्लास गजेन्द्र के अद्भुत उद्धार का उत्सव था।
text.en: Their joy celebrated Gajendra's wonderful deliverance.

source_attribution.note: Original short interpretive closing narration connecting the scripture's praise and flowers (8.4.1–2) to Gajendra's deliverance; not an additional quoted verse.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Huhu had regained his Gandharva form.

text.te: హూహూ తన గంధర్వ రూపాన్ని తిరిగి పొందాడు.
text.hi: हूहू ने अपना गंधर्व रूप वापस पा लिया।
text.en: Huhu had regained his Gandharva form.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narayana's mercy had ended his curse.

text.te: నారాయణుడి కరుణ వల్ల అతని శాపం ముగిసింది.
text.hi: नारायण की दया से उसका श्राप समाप्त हुआ।
text.en: Narayana's mercy had ended his curse.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Huhu respectfully circled the Lord.

text.te: హూహూ భక్తితో భగవంతుని చుట్టూ ప్రదక్షిణ చేశాడు.
text.hi: हूहू ने श्रद्धा से भगवान की परिक्रमा की।
text.en: Huhu respectfully circled the Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Then he bowed his head.

text.te: తరువాత తల వంచి నమస్కరించాడు.
text.hi: फिर सिर झुकाकर प्रणाम किया।
text.en: Then he bowed his head.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: With the devas looking on, he returned to Gandharvaloka.

text.te: దేవతలు చూస్తుండగా అతను గంధర్వలోకానికి తిరిగి వెళ్లాడు.
text.hi: देवताओं के सामने वह गंधर्व लोक लौट गया।
text.en: With the devas looking on, he returned to Gandharvaloka.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He was freed from the burden of his former curse.

text.te: తన తప్పు వల్ల వచ్చిన బంధనం నుంచి విముక్తి పొందాడు.
text.hi: वह अपने पुराने बंधन से मुक्त हो गया।
text.en: He was freed from the burden of his former curse.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He was restored to his original place.

text.te: ఇప్పుడు అతను మళ్లీ తన అసలు స్థానంలో ఉన్నాడు.
text.hi: अब वह फिर अपने मूल लोक में था।
text.en: He was restored to his original place.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Thus Huhu's earlier-life story reached its resolution.

text.te: అలా హూహూ పూర్వజన్మ కథ ముగిసింది.
text.hi: इस तरह हूहू की पिछली जन्म की कथा पूरी हुई।
text.en: Thus Huhu's earlier-life story reached its resolution.

source_attribution.note: Original serial narrative closure of Huhu's source-grounded gratitude and departure from 8.4.5; not independently quoted scriptural speech.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra's deliverance brought a deeper spiritual gift.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడి విముక్తికి మరో దివ్యమైన ఫలితం ఉంది.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र के उद्धार का एक और दिव्य फल था।
text.en: Gajendra's deliverance brought a deeper spiritual gift.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: By Narayana's touch, his ignorance was removed.

text.te: నారాయణుడి స్పర్శతో అతని అజ్ఞానం తొలగిపోయింది.
text.hi: नारायण के स्पर्श से उसका अज्ञान मिट गया।
text.en: By Narayana's touch, his ignorance was removed.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He was freed from material bondage too.

text.te: భౌతిక బంధనాల నుంచి కూడా అతను విముక్తి పొందాడు.
text.hi: वह भौतिक बंधनों से भी मुक्त हो गया।
text.en: He was freed from material bondage too.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: This liberation is called sārūpya-mukti.

text.te: ఈ విముక్తిని సారూప్య ముక్తి అంటారు.
text.hi: इस मुक्ति को सारूप्य-मुक्ति कहते हैं।
text.en: This liberation is called sārūpya-mukti.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He received a divine form with four arms.

text.te: అతనికి నాలుగు చేతులున్న దివ్య రూపం లభించింది.
text.hi: उसे चार भुजाओं वाला दिव्य रूप मिला।
text.en: He received a divine form with four arms.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Dressed in yellow, his spiritual form resembled the Lord's.

text.te: పసుపు వస్త్రాలు ధరించిన ఆ రూపం భగవంతునికి సాదృశ్యం కలిగి ఉంది.
text.hi: पीले वस्त्रों वाला वह रूप भगवान के समान दिव्य था।
text.en: Dressed in yellow, his spiritual form resembled the Lord's.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: It was no longer an ordinary elephant body.

text.te: అది సాధారణ ఏనుగు రూపం కాదు.
text.hi: वह साधारण हाथी का शरीर नहीं था।
text.en: It was no longer an ordinary elephant body.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra became a spiritual associate of Narayana.

text.te: నారాయణుడి సేవకు గజేంద్రుడు దివ్య సహచరుడయ్యాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र भगवान नारायण का दिव्य सहचर बन गया।
text.en: Gajendra became a spiritual associate of Narayana.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Hari, pleased with Gajendra, spoke blessings.

text.te: హరి సంతోషించి గజేంద్రుడిని ఆశీర్వదించాడు.
text.hi: हरि प्रसन्न होकर गजेन्द्र को आशीर्वाद देने लगे।
text.en: Hari, pleased with Gajendra, spoke blessings.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He spoke of remembering His form, Gajendra and the lake.

text.te: తన దివ్య రూపాన్ని, గజేంద్రుడిని, ఆ సరస్సును స్మరించమని చెప్పారు.
text.hi: उन्होंने अपने रूप, गजेन्द्र और उस झील को स्मरण करने को कहा।
text.en: He spoke of remembering His form, Gajendra and the lake.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He recalled Trikuta and its three great peaks.

text.te: త్రికూట పర్వతాన్ని, దాని మూడు శిఖరాలను కూడా గుర్తు చేశారు.
text.hi: उन्होंने त्रिकूट पर्वत और उसकी तीन चोटियों का स्मरण कराया।
text.en: He recalled Trikuta and its three great peaks.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The divine remembrance also included Sudarshana, Panchajanya and Garuda.

text.te: సుదర్శన చక్రం, పాంచజన్య శంఖం, గరుడుడి పేర్లు కూడా ఆయన దివ్య స్మరణలో ఉన్నాయి.
text.hi: उन्होंने सुदर्शन चक्र, पाञ्चजन्य शंख और गरुड़ का भी स्मरण कराया।
text.en: The divine remembrance also included Sudarshana, Panchajanya and Garuda.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: It also included devoted people, sages and sacred places.

text.te: అనేక భక్తులు, మహర్షులు, పవిత్ర స్థలాలు కూడా ఆ స్మరణలో ఉన్నాయి.
text.hi: उस स्मरण में अनेक भक्त, ऋषि और पवित्र स्थान भी आते हैं।
text.en: It also included devoted people, sages and sacred places.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He spoke of the blessing of remembering Him attentively in the morning.

text.te: తెల్లవారుజామున మనసు నిలిపి భగవంతుడిని స్మరించడం పుణ్యమని చెప్పారు.
text.hi: उन्होंने कहा कि प्रातः मन लगाकर भगवान को याद करना पवित्र है।
text.en: He spoke of the blessing of remembering Him attentively in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He blessed such devotees with a spiritual destination.

text.te: అలాంటి భక్తులకు దివ్యమైన గతి లభిస్తుందని ఆశీర్వదించారు.
text.hi: उन्होंने ऐसे भक्तों को अंत में दिव्य गति का आशीर्वाद दिया।
text.en: He blessed such devotees with a spiritual destination.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra received those blessings with devotion.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు ఆ కరుణామయమైన ఆశీర్వాదాలను భక్తితో స్వీకరించాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने उन करुणामय आशीर्वादों को श्रद्धा से ग्रहण किया।
text.en: Gajendra received those blessings with devotion.

source_attribution.note: Original natural reaction for the already scripted Lord-given blessings in 8.4.16–25; the numbered verses do not require a separate visible gesture or line by Gajendra.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: After the blessings, Hari lifted His conch.

text.te: ఆశీర్వాదాలు ఇచ్చిన తరువాత హరి తన శంఖాన్ని తీసుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: आशीर्वाद देकर हरि ने अपना शंख उठाया।
text.en: After the blessings, Hari lifted His conch.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: That conch was called Panchajanya.

text.te: ఆ శంఖం పేరు పాంచజన్యం.
text.hi: उस शंख का नाम पाञ्चजन्य था।
text.en: That conch was called Panchajanya.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narayana sounded Panchajanya.

text.te: నారాయణుడు పాంచజన్యాన్ని ఊదాడు.
text.hi: नारायण ने पाञ्चजन्य शंख बजाया।
text.en: Narayana sounded Panchajanya.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The divine sound delighted the devas.

text.te: దాని దివ్య నాదంతో దేవతలు సంతోషించారు.
text.hi: उस दिव्य ध्वनि से देवता प्रसन्न हुए।
text.en: The divine sound delighted the devas.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Those gathered praised the Lord's rescue once more.

text.te: అక్కడ ఉన్నవారు భగవంతుని కార్యాన్ని మరోసారి స్తుతించారు.
text.hi: वहाँ उपस्थित सबने भगवान के कार्य की फिर स्तुति की।
text.en: Those gathered praised the Lord's rescue once more.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The celebration of flowers and praise filled the scene.

text.te: పూల వర్షం, స్తుతుల ఆనందం ఇంకా ఆ ప్రదేశంలో కనిపించింది.
text.hi: फूलों और स्तुति का उत्सव उस स्थान पर जारी था।
text.en: The celebration of flowers and praise filled the scene.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Garuda gently opened his wings.

text.te: గరుడుడు తన రెక్కలను నెమ్మదిగా విప్పాడు.
text.hi: गरुड़ ने धीरे से अपने पंख फैलाए।
text.en: Garuda gently opened his wings.

source_attribution.note: Original natural wing-opening anticipation before the scripture's remount (8.4.26), not a separately asserted verse event or audio recording.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Lord was ready to mount Garuda again.

text.te: ఇప్పుడు భగవంతుడు గరుడుడిపై తిరిగి ఎక్కబోతున్నాడు.
text.hi: अब भगवान फिर गरुड़ पर चढ़ने वाले थे।
text.en: The Lord was ready to mount Garuda again.
